title: Hit-Ahead Pass off the Dribble
description: In transition, the ball handler passes ahead to a teammate who is in front of the ball without picking up the dribble, because the ball travels faster than any dribbler.

content.objective: Pass ahead to the most advanced open teammate straight off the dribble, keeping the break moving.
content.setup: Ball handler at the baseline with a ball; two wings sprinting in the outside lanes.
content.organization: Groups of three; the next group goes when the court is clear.
instructions: The ball handler pushes the ball up the middle.
The wings sprint wide and ahead of the ball.
Before half court, the ball handler hits the most advanced wing with a one-hand push pass off the dribble.
The wing catches in stride and attacks the rim.
If the wing is covered, the handler keeps dribbling and hits the other side.
coachingPoints: Look up the floor on the first dribble.
Pass off the dribble: no pick-up, no pause.
Wings run wide and look back over the inside shoulder.
commonMistakes: Dribbling the ball all the way up the floor.
Picking up the ball before passing, which slows the break.
Wings running inside the lane lines.
content.safety: Wide running lanes; finishers clear the baseline straight away.
progressions: Add a retreating defender who protects the rim.
Hit-ahead to the trailer on the second pass.
variations: Hit-ahead to the corner for a three.
Ball handler finishes if both wings are covered.
successCriteria: Hit-ahead pass made before half court on most reps.
content.gameApplication: Teams that pass ahead score before the defense is set; dribbling up the floor gives defenders time.
